about: The bar's loops (looped/loops.h, docs/LOOPED.md D2). Each one is a little piece of life the world plays by itself, on the room's clock, so everyone sees the same. Ask Claude for a new one in plain words; this file is all it takes.

songs.about: Tempo and first beat of the built-in songs (measured from the files), so loops on the beat lock to the music. Your own songs play loops in seconds.

loops.about: Three moths circling the second lamp over the counter; they dart off if you come close.
Two moths at the last lamp over the counter.
Sparks rising over the fireplace while the fire is on.
The fireplace's light flickers like a real fire.
The pink light by the ARCADE sign buzzes now and then, like old neon.
The arcade's colored lights breathe one after another, like a slow wave.
The jukebox's glow thumps on every beat of the song (breathes slowly when it's quiet).
The ceiling lights swell very softly every two beats while music plays.
